# n-tabs

> Tab container managing tab selection, panel visibility, and a sliding indicator.

**Class:** `NTabs`

**ARIA role:** `tablist`
**Internal controllers:** `PressController`, `ListNavigateController`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` |  | Currently selected tab value |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables all tabs |
| `orientation` | `string` |  | Layout direction: "horizontal" | "vertical" |

## CSS Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Values | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `pressed` | boolean | _(boolean)_ | Visually shows a tab in its active/pressed state |
| `inline` | boolean | _(boolean)_ | Switches from block-level to inline display |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `native:change` | _(none)_ | Fired when the active tab changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

|-------|---------|---------|
| `--n-border-muted` |  | Muted border color |
| `--n-button-font-weight` |  | Font weight |
| `--n-control-line-height` |  | Line height |
| `--n-duration` |  | Transition duration |
| `--n-easing` |  | Transition easing |

| `--n-font-weight` | `var(--n-button-font-weight)` | Font weight |
| `--n-indicator-index` | `0` | Zero-based index of the selected tab, used to position the sliding indicator |
| `--n-ink-active` |  | Ink (text) color |
| `--n-ink-disabled` |  | Ink when disabled |
| `--n-ink-hover` |  | Ink on hover |
| `--n-ink-muted` |  | Ink (text) color |

| `--n-surface-ink` |  | Ink (text) color |
| `--n-surface-ink-hover` |  | Ink on hover |

| `--n-tabs-indicator` |  | Color of the sliding tab indicator line |

## Accessibility

- **Role:** `tablist`

### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `ArrowRight` | Moves focus to the next tab (horizontal orientation) |
| `ArrowLeft` | Moves focus to the previous tab (horizontal orientation) |
| `ArrowDown` | Moves focus to the next tab (vertical orientation) |
| `ArrowUp` | Moves focus to the previous tab (vertical orientation) |
| `Home` | Moves focus to the first tab |
| `End` | Moves focus to the last tab |
| `Enter` | Activates the focused tab |
| `Space` | Activates the focused tab |

## Behavior

- **native:select on n-tab** → Updates selected value, shows matching panel, repositions indicator, dispatches native:change
- **disabled attribute change** → Cascades disabled state to all child n-tab elements

## Composition

### Children
- `<n-tab>`
- `<n-tab-panels>`
- `<n-tab-panel>`

## Compatible Traits

`hover`, `focus-visible`

## Usage

### Minimal

```html
<n-tabs></n-tabs>
```

### Examples

```html
<n-tabs id="event-tabs" value="first">
        <n-tab value="first">First</n-tab>
        <n-tab value="second">Second</n-tab>
        <n-tab value="third">Third</n-tab>
        <n-tab-panels>
          <n-tab-panel value="first"><p>First panel. Switch tabs to see events logged below.</p></n-tab-panel>
          <n-tab-panel value="second"><p>Second panel.</p></n-tab-panel>
          <n-tab-panel value="third"><p>Third panel.</p></n-tab-panel>
        </n-tab-panels>
      </n-tabs>
```

```html
<n-tabs value="one" size="lg">
          <n-tab value="one">Large</n-tab>
          <n-tab value="two">Tabs</n-tab>
          <n-tab value="three">Here</n-tab>
          <n-tab-panels>
            <n-tab-panel value="one"><p>Large size panel.</p></n-tab-panel>
            <n-tab-panel value="two"><p>Second large panel.</p></n-tab-panel>
            <n-tab-panel value="three"><p>Third large panel.</p></n-tab-panel>
          </n-tab-panels>
        </n-tabs>
```

```html
<n-tabs value="normal">
        <n-tab value="hover" force-hover>Force hover</n-tab>
        <n-tab value="active" force-active>Force active</n-tab>
        <n-tab value="focus" force-focus-visible>Force focus-visible</n-tab>
        <n-tab value="normal">Normal</n-tab>
      </n-tabs>
```
